description: This Java class configures OpenAPI documentation metadata for the Notes Backend API using Spring Boot annotations and Swagger/OpenAPI models.

classes.name: OpenApiConfig
classes.description: Spring configuration class that defines a Bean for OpenAPI documentation, including API metadata and external documentation links.

methods.name: notesOpenAPI
methods.description: Defines and returns the OpenAPI Bean with API info such as title, version, description, contact, and external docs.
